blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: High-resolution isotropic brain MRI is important for accurate diagnosis, surgical planning, and longitudinal monitoring of neurological disease [ 46 , 30 ] . In routine clinical practice, and particularly in resource-constrained settings where scanner availability, patient throughput, and acquisition time are major constraints, brain MR examinations are often conducted with fast 2D multi-slice protocols with thick slices, employed to keep scan time low, mitigate motion, and maintain signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) [ 46 , 30 , 2 ] . Although these protocols achieve high in-plane resolution, they suffer from poor through-plane resolution, producing anisotropic 3D stacks that hinder volumetric analysis and multi-planar review. To partially compensate for this limitation, clinical protocols commonly acquire multiple stacks across axial, coronal and sagittal orientations [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 高分辨异性脑核磁共振对准确诊断,外科规划,神经病纵向监测[46,30]具有重要意义. 在常规的临床实践中,特别是在资源受限制的环境下,扫描仪的可用性、病人的吞吐量和获取时间是主要制约因素,大脑MR检查往往使用有厚切片的快取2D多切片协议进行,用于保持扫描时间低,减缓运动,并保持信号-噪声比(SNR) [46, 30, 2]. 虽然这些协议在飞机中实现了高分辨率,但通过飞机分辨率却很差,产生异同位素的3D堆积物,阻碍体积分析和多平面审查. 为了部分地补偿这一限制,临床协议通常会获得多堆横跨轴线,冠线和斜向[2].

blocks.en: Super-resolution reconstruction (SRR) seeks to recover a single isotropic high-resolution (HR) volume from one or more anisotropic low-resolution (LR) stacks. Multi-stack SRR exploits complementary content of orthogonal acquisitions, where each stack provides high-fidelity information in its in-plane directions while lacking the through-plane detail [ 46 , 17 ] . The central methodological challenge is therefore to fuse these incomplete, orientation-specific observations into a geometrically consistent volumetric representation, ideally without per-subject optimisation or expensive iterative slice-to-volume registration.
blocks.zh: 超级分辨率重建(SRR)寻求从一个或多个异同位素低分辨率(LR)堆栈中回收出一个单一同位素高分辨率(HR)体积. Multi-stack SR利用正统收购的互补内容,每堆在飞机上提供高真实度信息,而缺乏穿机细节[46,17]. 因此,在方法上的主要挑战是将这些不完整的、针对具体方向的观测结果整合成几何一致的体积表示,最好是不逐一优化或费用高昂的迭接分片到体积登记。

blocks.en: The classical line of work formulates SRR as a model-based inverse problem solved by iterative slice-to-volume registration and optimisation [ 17 , 14 , 54 , 53 ] . These methods are well established in fetal MRI, where extreme inter-slice motion makes registration a dominant difficulty. However, they are computationally expensive and can be brittle in heterogeneous adult cohorts and low-resource clinical settings, where fast 2D acquisitions remain the norm. Learning-based SRR methods can be broadly divided into supervised and self-supervised methods. Supervised models are trained once on paired LR-HR datasets and then applied directly to new scans [ 11 , 22 ] . However, many learned SRR methods operate on a single anisotropic stack, making the reconstruction problem severely under-constrained in the through-plane direction and potentially prone to blurring, loss of fine structure, or hallucinated anatomy [ 23 , 47 , 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 古典的工作线将SRR设定为以模型为基础的反向问题,通过迭接切片到量的注册和优化来解决 [17, 14, 54, 53]. 在胎儿核磁共振中,这些方法早已确立,极端的间切运动使登记成为主要困难。 然而,它们计算成本很高,在不同的成人群体和低资源临床环境中可能很脆弱,在这种环境中,快速2D获取仍然是常态。 基于学习的SRR方法可以大致分为受监督的方法和自监督的方法. 监督模型在配对的LR-HR数据集上培训一次,然后直接被应用到新的扫描上[11,22]. 然而,许多所学的SRR方法在单一的同位素堆上运作,使得重建问题在穿平面方向上严重不足,并有可能被模糊,失去精细的结构,或者幻觉解剖[23,47,28].

blocks.en: Beyond the through-plane ambiguity, single-stack reconstruction is also limited by the anatomical extent of the selected acquisition. In routine clinical protocols, axial, coronal and sagittal stacks may be prescribed with different partial fields-of-view (FOVs) [ 2 , 29 ] . Consequently, anatomy or pathology that is absent from one orientation may still be visible in another. For example, an axial stack prescribed with limited superior-inferior coverage may exclude an extra-axial lesion near the vertex, whereas the same lesion may be captured in the sagittal stack. This type of orientation-specific variation in anatomical coverage is shown in the appendix ( Figure A.8 ). A method that reconstructs from the axial stack alone cannot recover such clinically relevant information, regardless of its super-resolution capacity. This motivates multi-stack SRR methods that exploit complementary orientation-specific coverage rather than treating each stack in isolation.

blocks.en: Self-supervised learned reconstruction methods such as SMORE [ 57 ] , ECLARE [ 39 ] and TripleSR [ 41 ] reduce the need for paired supervised training data by optimising a model using only the available anisotropic scan. However, these approaches typically require a computationally heavy per-subject optimisation at inference and therefore do not provide a single reusable model that can immediately reconstruct arbitrary subsets of axial, coronal and sagittal inputs. Flexible fusion of missing or incomplete inputs has been studied in multi-modal segmentation, including HeMIS [ 21 ] and U-HVED [ 12 ] , but analogous flexibility remains less explored for multi-stack MRI super-resolution, where the absence arises not only from absent input orientations but also from spatially varying FOV within each orientation.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习到的重建方法,如SMORE [57],ECLARE [39]和TripleSR [41],通过只使用现有的异同位素扫描优化一个模型来减少对配对的被监督训练数据的需求. 然而,这些方法通常要求在推论中计算出每个主体的重度优化,因此不能提供单一的可再使用模型,可以立即重建轴向、冠向和斜向输入的任意子集. 在多模式分解(包括HEMIS[21]和U-HVED[12])中,对缺失或不完整投入的灵活组合进行了研究,但在多堆核磁共振超解方面,类似的灵活性仍然较少得到探讨,因为缺乏这种灵活性的原因不仅在于缺乏投入取向,而且在于每个取向中空间上的差异。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed MS-HVED framework. Given any non-empty subset of axial, coronal and sagittal anisotropic stacks, each available orientation is processed by an independent variational encoder that predicts latent multi-scale Gaussian posterior parameters. The resulting orientation-specific latent posteriors are fused voxel-wise using a Multi-Scale Product-of-Gaussians, where per-orientation FOV masks modulate each stack’s precision contribution according to its spatial extent. Samples from the fused latent multi-scale posterior are passed through a shared super-resolution decoder to reconstruct the isotropic HR volume. Optional orientation-specific decoders reconstruct the input stacks.

blocks.en: We introduce MS-HVED , a flexible hetero-orientation variational framework for multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. As shown in Figure 1 , each available orientation is encoded independently into a latent multi-scale Gaussian posterior, and the available posteriors are fused using a Product-of-Gaussians (PoG). Because fusion is defined over the set of available orientations, the same network can reconstruct from any non-empty subset 𝒪 ⊆ { Ax , Cor , Sag } \mathcal{O}\subseteq\{\text{Ax},\text{Cor},\text{Sag}\} at inference. This allows the model to use one, two or three input stacks without retraining or changing the network architecture.

blocks.en: This flexible fusion is paired with explicit modelling of the acquisition geometry encountered in real clinical multi-stack scans. Axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are rarely perfectly aligned with a canonical reference frame. Each stack may be prescribed at an oblique angle, and after registration to a common isotropic grid the resampled stack can occupy a rotated and partially valid grid, with invalid or weakly supported regions near the volume boundaries. A simple preprocessing workaround is to trim poorly supported edge slices after resampling, but this is a heuristic outside the reconstruction model and often discards useful measurements. MS-HVED instead makes stack prescription part of both training and inference, specifically, the forward model simulates acquisition obliqueness and partial-FOV, and the fusion module receives per-orientation FOV masks that modulate each stack’s precision contribution at the voxel level.

MS-HVED则将堆栈处方作为培训和推论的一部分,具体来说,前置模型模拟了获取偏斜性和部分偏斜性,而聚变模块则接收到每个方向的FOV口罩来调制每个堆栈的精密贡献.

blocks.en: Evaluating multi-stack MRI super-resolution is also challenging. Synthetic LR-HR experiments provide known references and controlled acquisition geometry, but may not fully capture the mismatch observed in real clinical data. Paired real LR-HR acquisitions provide a more realistic reference, but are scarce and when available, the LR and HR scans are acquired separately and may differ in contrast, intensity scale, motion state, etc. Finally, many clinically important datasets have no matched isotropic HR reference, requiring qualitative, expert-reader or task-based evaluation. We therefore evaluate MS-HVED using complementary protocols: full-reference quantitative metrics on synthetic benchmarks, blinded expert-reader evaluation on reference-free clinical cohorts as well as downstream tissue-segmentation analysis.
blocks.zh: 评估多层磁共振超强分辨率也具有挑战性。 合成LR-HR实验提供了已知的参考和可控获取几何,但可能无法完全捕捉到在真实临床数据中观察到的错配. Paired real LR-HR收购提供了更现实的参考,但稀缺,在有可用的情况下,LR和HR扫描是单独获得的,在对比度,强度尺度,运动状态等方面可能有所不同. 最后,许多临床上重要的数据集没有对应的同位素人力资源参考,需要定性、专家阅读或任务评价。 因此,我们利用补充协议对MS-HVED进行评估:关于合成基准的全参考量度测量,关于无参考量临床组群的盲目专家-阅读者评价以及下游组织分解分析。

blocks.en: Across multiple experiments, MS-HVED achieves best or competitive reconstruction quality while retaining flexibility across input configurations. Ablation experiments show that oblique partial-FOV simulation and FOV-aware fusion are important for robust reconstruction under realistic acquisition geometry. On paired real healthy-control data, MS-HVED improves perceptual quality and structural similarity over the baselines. In blinded expert review, MS-HVED received higher ratings than the strongest baseline for overall quality, SNR, artefact reduction, and anatomical consistency, and this preference persisted when specific input stacks were unavailable.
blocks.zh: 通过多项实验,MS-HVED实现了最佳或竞争性的重建质量,同时保留了各种输入配置的灵活性. 通缩实验表明,偏斜部分-FOV模拟和FOV-意识聚变对于在现实的获取几何学下进行强力重建很重要. 在成对的真正的健康控制数据上,MS-HVED在基线上提高了知觉质量和结构相似性. 在被蒙蔽的专家审查中,MS-HVED在整体质量,SNR,蒿素减量,解剖一致性方面得到的评分高于最强的基准,在具体输入堆栈没有时,这种偏好仍然存在.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are: 1. Flexible hetero-orientation variational fusion. We formulate multi-stack brain MRI SRR as a hetero-orientation fusion problem, where each available orientation contributes a multi-scale Gaussian posterior to a shared latent representation. A single model can reconstruct from any non-empty subset of axial, coronal and sagittal inputs without retraining. 2. FOV-aware Product-of-Gaussians fusion. We extend PoG fusion with per-orientation, per-voxel FOV masks that encode the spatial support of each stack. Unsupported regions purposely do not contribute to the fused posterior, while smooth mask boundaries reduce discontinuities near stack edges. 3. Physics-informed domain randomisation for clinical multi-stack MRI. We propose a synthetic forward model that simulates anisotropic resolution, slice-profile effects, oblique stack prescription, partial-FOV coverage, motion ghosting, k-space artefacts, bias fields and Rician noise, enabling supervised training without requiring large paired LR-HR clinical datasets. 4. Spectrally normalised variational architecture. We avoid activation normalisation layers in the reconstruction backbone to preserve intensity relationships between the inputs and reconstructions, and stabilise posterior prediction using spectral normalisation. 5. Comprehensive evaluation across synthetic, real (paired and reference-free) clinical settings. We evaluate reconstruction fidelity, missing-orientation robustness, sequence-agnostic generalisation, downstream segmentation utility and clinical image quality, providing a comprehensive assessment than voxel-wise similarity metrics alone. 6. Open-source implementation. Our code and model weights are open-source at https://github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved to support reproducibility and future benchmarking.

blocks.zh: 综合评价,涵盖人工合成、真实(无参考)临床环境。 我们评价重建的忠诚度、缺乏定向的强性、序列不可知的概括性、下游分化的效用和临床图像质量,仅提供一种综合的评估,而不只是以阴道相似性衡量。

blocks.en: Open-source implementation. Our code and model weights are open-source at https://github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved to support reproducibility and future benchmarking.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Single-stack MRI super-resolution
blocks.zh: 2.1 单层磁共振超分辨率

blocks.en: Convolutional super-resolution networks were introduced for natural images by [ 11 ] and have since been transferred to MRI. Jurek et al. [26] apply 3D CNNs to recover isotropic resolution from a single thick-slice acquisition. SMORE [ 57 ] achieves anti-aliasing and through-plane super-resolution from a single anisotropic volume in a self-supervised framework by exploiting the higher resolution of in-plane patches. ECLARE [ 39 ] extends this idea by estimating the slice excitation profile via ESPRESO [ 19 ] and training a per-subject network on cross-planar in-plane patches. More recent arbitrary-scale approaches use implicit or explicit neural representations to handle variable slice spacing [ 48 , 37 ] , and diffusion models have been adapted to brain and body MRI SR with mechanisms to reduce sampling cost [ 20 , 58 ] .
blocks.zh: 由[11]引入了革命超分辨率网络,用于自然图像,后被转移到核磁共振. Jurek等编. [26] 应用三维有线电视新闻网从单一厚片获取中取回异地分辨率. SMORE [57]通过利用飞机上补丁的更高分辨率,在自我监督的框架中从单个同位素体积中实现反异化和通过飞机超解. ECLARE[39]扩展了这一想法,通过ESPRESO[19]估算了片段的引人入胜概况,并培训了每题一个跨平面平面补丁的网络. 较近期的任意尺度方法使用隐含或显性神经表达处理可变切片间隔[48,37],并针对大脑和身体核磁共振调整了扩散模型,并建立了降低取样成本的机制[20,58]。

blocks.en: While powerful, single-stack methods remain intrinsically limited by the information available in the selected acquisition [ 46 , 4 , 5 ] . First, through-plane detail is under-constrained when only one anisotropic view is observed. Missing high-frequency structure must be inferred from learned priors or within-stack context, which can lead to blurring, hallucinated anatomy, or contrast inversions on out-of-distribution clinical data [ 4 , 5 ] . Second, and more importantly for routine multi-orientation protocols, a single stack is limited by its anatomical extent. If a pathology or structure lies outside the prescribed FOV of the selected stack, it cannot be recovered by any single-stack SR method.
blocks.zh: 单套方法虽然强大,但因选定获取中的信息而存在固有的局限性[46、4、5]。 首先,在只观测到一种异同位素时,通过平面细节就受到不足的限制. 缺失的高频结构必须从所学的前科或上层环境推断出,这会导致模糊不清,产生幻觉解剖学,或者在分配外临床数据上形成对比倒置[4,5]. 第二,更重要的是,对于例行的多取向协议来说,一个堆栈受到解剖范围的限制。 如果一个病理或结构位于所选堆栈的指定FOV之外,则无法用任何单层的SR方法取回.

blocks.en: A complementary line of work pre-trains generative priors and uses them at inference. SynthSR [ 23 ] demonstrates that aggressive domain randomisation, i.e. sampling contrasts, resolutions, and artefacts from vast distributions during training, enables strong cross-domain generalisation in a single feed-forward pass, but the model still operates on a single stack at inference. InverseSR [ 47 ] formulates SR as latent-diffusion inversion using a 3D brain-MRI prior, and MRIFlow [ 28 ] uses a normalising flow with a frequency prior. These methods produce sharp reconstructions, but they require iterative inference or a learned prior over a target distribution and do not provide a natural mechanism for fusing complementary information from multiple anisotropic stacks.
blocks.zh: 一种互补的先入为主的工作线,在推断时使用。 SynthSR [23] 表明有侵略性域随机化,即从训练期间的大规模分布中取样对比,分辨率,和手工艺品,可以使一个向导的单行传中强烈地跨域泛化,但模型仍然在一行堆上运行,推论. 反向SR [47] 使用3D脑-MRI的前作将SR作为潜向分泌倒置,而MRIFlow [28] 使用频率前作的正态流. 这些方法产生尖锐的再生,但它们需要反复推论或先于目标分布而获得知识,不能为从多同位素堆栈中分解补充信息提供自然机制.

blocks.en: 2.2 Multi-stack MRI super-resolution
blocks.zh: 2.2 多堆核磁共振超分辨率

blocks.en: Multi-stack super-resolution and slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) have been studied extensively in fetal MRI, where extreme inter-slice motion makes registration the dominant difficulty. Classical optimisation based pipelines [ 17 , 14 ] explicitly model the acquisition forward problem and alternate between volume reconstruction and slice-to-volume registration. They produce high-quality reconstructions but are computationally expensive and sensitive to registration failures, limiting their scalability to large heterogeneous clinical cohorts. Learning-based variants speed up the registration step using transformers [ 54 ] , replace the volume parameterisation with implicit neural representations [ 53 ] , or learn slice-profile conditioned generative networks [ 32 ] . Most recently, [ 22 ] learn multi-view interpolation weights for fetal-brain SRR.
blocks.zh: 在胎儿核磁共振(Fetal MRI)中广泛研究了多层超解析和切片到体积重建(SVR),极端的切片间运动使得注册成为了最主要的困难. 古典优化型管线[17,14]明确标出购入前期问题并交替为批量重建与分批量登记. 它们的重建质量很高,但计算成本高,而且对登记失败很敏感,因此其可扩展性仅限于不同的大型临床群体。 基于学习的变体加快了使用变压器的注册步骤[54],将体积参数化替换为隐含的神经表达[53],或学习切片可控基因网络[32]. 最近,[22]学习了胎脑SRR的多视图插值权重.

blocks.en: In adult brain MRI, where inter-slice motion is typically more moderate, several works specifically address learned multi-stack reconstruction. TripleSR [ 41 ] fuses two orthogonal anisotropic stacks using an implicit neural representation trained with a sparse coordinate-based loss in continuous space. It is self-supervised and effective in its two-view setting, but it performs computationally heavy per-subject optimisation and does not directly support a third stack or a missing input orientation within one reusable model. Recent supervised orthogonal-scan methods also show the value of combining complementary anatomical views with 3D CNNs [ 42 ] , but they still assume a fixed input set. This motivates evaluating fixed-input baselines alongside a flexible model that can operate on arbitrary subsets of axial, coronal and sagittal stacks.
blocks.zh: 在成人大脑核磁共振中,切片间运动一般比较中度,有几部作品专门涉及所学多层重建. TripleSR [41] 使用在连续空间中经过少量坐标损失训练的隐性神经元来引信两个正交异构堆. 它在其双视图设置中是自我监督并有效的,但它在计算上进行每个主体的重优化,不直接支持第三堆或一个可重复使用的模型中缺失的输入取向. 最近被监督的正交-扫描方法也显示出将互补解剖视图与3D CNN [42] 结合的价值,但它们仍然假设一个固定的输入集. 这促使人们评价固定投入基线,同时采用灵活的模型,在轴、冠和平面堆放的任意子集上运作。

blocks.en: Most learning-based multi-stack SRR studies simplify either the input availability problem or the acquisition geometry. In the first case, models are trained for a fixed set of orientations and cannot directly adapt when one orientation is absent. In the second case, stacks are often treated as axis-aligned fully overlapping volumes. However, real clinical stacks may be obliquely prescribed and may provide only partial FOV.
blocks.zh: 大多数基于学习的多堆SRR研究都简化了输入可用性问题或获取几何. 在第一种情况下,模型是为一套固定的取向而训练的,在缺少一个取向时无法直接适应. 在第二种情况下,堆栈往往被视为轴向完全相重叠的卷. 然而,真实的临床堆栈可能是偏斜处方,可能只提供部分FOV.

blocks.en: 2.3 Hetero-modal and probabilistic fusion
blocks.zh: 2.3 异式和概率聚变

blocks.en: The idea of fusing variable subsets of inputs through a shared probabilistic latent space comes from multi-modal segmentation. HeMIS [ 21 ] aggregates per-modality features using first and second-order statistics, supporting any non-empty subset of input modalities. U-HVED [ 12 ] reformulates this idea as a hetero-modal variational encoder-decoder where each modality contributes a Gaussian posterior to a shared latent space through Product-of-Experts fusion, and a single trained model performs joint segmentation and modality completion under arbitrary subsets of available modalities.
blocks.zh: 通过共享概率潜入空间来分解可变输入子集的想法来自多模式分化。 HeMIS [21] 使用一阶和二阶统计法对每个模式的特征进行汇总,支持任何非空输入模式子集. U-HVED [12] 将这一想法改写为异式可变编码器-解码器,每种模式都通过Product-Experts聚变为共享潜在空间提供高斯后音,单一的训练有素模式在任意分集现有模式下进行联合分解并完成模式.

blocks.en: Although these hetero-modal approaches provide a useful mechanism for handling missing input channels, they were developed primarily for segmentation problems rather than geometric super-resolution. In those setups, missingness is treated at the input level where a modality is either available or absent. Multi-stack SRR introduces an additional spatial form of missingness because of the anatomical extent of the inputs.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些异式方法为处理缺失的输入通道提供了一个有用的机制,但它们主要是针对分解问题而不是几何超分辨率而开发的. 在这些设置中,在有某种模式或没有某种模式时,在输入一级处理缺失问题。 由于输入的解剖范围,多层空间堆积SRR引入了额外的空间缺失形式.

blocks.en: 2.4 Domain randomisation
blocks.zh: 2.4 域随机

blocks.en: A major obstacle to supervised SRR is the scarcity of paired LR-HR clinical data. Domain randomisation , popularized in robotics [ 43 ] and adapted for medical imaging by SynthSR [ 23 ] and SynthSeg [ 6 ] , addresses this problem by training on synthetic data generated from broad distributions over contrast, resolution, and artefacts, on the premise that a sufficiently randomized training distribution covers the true clinical distribution as a special case.
blocks.zh: 受监督的SRR的一个主要障碍是配对的LR-HR临床数据缺乏. 域随机化,在机器人[43]中被普及,并被SynthSR[23]和SynthSeg [6]用于医学成像,通过对从对比、分辨率和手工艺品的广泛分布所产生的合成数据进行培训来解决这一问题,前提是充分随机化的培训分布涵盖作为特例的真正临床分布。

blocks.en: In MRI super-resolution, domain randomisation has most often focused on intensity contrast, resolution, noise, bias fields, and other appearance level or degradation level factors. These components are important for cross dataset robustness, but they do not fully capture the geometry of routine multi-stack acquisitions. Existing randomisation strategies therefore leave a gap between synthetic LR generation and the spatial patterns observed in clinical multi-orientation protocols. This motivates randomisation schemes that model not only image degradation, but also acquisition geometry and orientation-specific FOV.
blocks.zh: 在核磁共振超分辨率中,域随机化最常侧重于强度对比,分辨率,噪声,偏差场等外观水平或退化水平因素. 这些组件对于跨数据集的稳健性很重要,但它们并没有完全捕捉到常规多堆购置的几何. 因此,现有的随机化战略在合成LR生成与临床多方向协议所观察到的空间模式之间留下了空白. 这激励了随机化计划,它不仅模拟了图像退化,而且获得了几何和定向特定的FOV.

blocks.en: 2.5 Evaluation and benchmarking of MRI super-resolution
blocks.zh: 2.5 核磁共振超分辨率的评估和基准

blocks.en: Benchmarking MRI super-resolution is challenging because reconstruction quality is not fully captured by a single metric. Full-reference measures such as PSNR, SSIM, MAE/RMSE and normalised cross-correlation are useful when a HR reference is available, and remain widely used in MRI reconstruction, synthesis and super-resolution studies. However, voxel-wise and structural metrics can favour overly smooth reconstructions, are sensitive to intensity normalisation and spatial misregistration, and may not reflect the preservation of clinically relevant anatomy [ 10 , 1 ] . Perceptual or feature-based metrics provide complementary information about sharpness and structural plausibility, but they are often derived from natural-image feature spaces and should be interpreted cautiously in medical imaging [ 55 , 1 ] . In addition, high image-level similarity does not necessarily imply improved clinical or downstream utility, such as tissue segmentation, lesion assessment or diagnostic confidence [ 56 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 确定核磁共振超高分辨率的基准具有挑战性,因为重建质量没有完全用一个衡量标准来衡量。 全面参考措施,如PSNR,SSIM,MAE/RMSE和常态交叉关系等,在有HR参考时是有用的,并仍然被广泛用于核磁共振重建,合成和超分辨率研究. 然而,Voxel-wisel和结构度量法可能有利于过于平稳的重建,对强度正常化和空间误入登记敏感,可能无法反映临床相关解剖学的保存[10, 1]. 认知或以特征为基础的度量法提供了锋利性和结构合理性的互补信息,但它们往往取自自然成像特征空间,应当在医学成像中谨慎地解释[55, 1]. 此外,高图像水平的相似性并不一定意味着临床或下游用途的改善,如组织分化,损伤评估或诊断自信[56,3].

blocks.en: Most MRI SR studies therefore use a combination of full-reference quantitative metrics and qualitative assessment. Early and recent learning-based SR methods commonly report PSNR, SSIM, RMSE/MAE or related measures on synthetically downsampled data, where an HR target is known by construction [ 26 , 57 , 39 , 41 ] . Other studies evaluate on paired LR-HR acquisitions [ 13 ] , which better reflect real imaging conditions but introduce a pseudo-reference problem: the HR scan is acquired separately and may differ in contrast or noise. In such cases, quantitative scores measure similarity to the available HR acquisition rather than absolute reconstruction accuracy.
blocks.zh: 大多数磁共振 因此,斯洛伐克共和国的研究采用全面参照定量衡量和定性评估相结合的方法。 早期和近期基于学习的SR方法通常报告PSNR、SSIM、RMSE/MAE或关于合成下取样数据的相关措施,其中通过构建来了解人力资源目标[26、57、39、41]。 其他研究评价了配对的LR-HR收购[13],这更能反映真实的成像条件,但引入了伪参考问题:HR扫描是单独获得的,在对比或噪音上可能有所不同. 在这种情况下,定量分数衡量的是与现有人力资源获取的相似性,而不是绝对重建的准确性。

blocks.en: Several MRI SR and accelerated reconstruction studies have therefore incorporated expert reader studies to assess clinical image quality directly. Chaudhari et al. [8] evaluated musculoskeletal MRI SR using both quantitative metrics and a radiologist reader study, with readers assessing sharpness, contrast, artefacts, SNR and overall diagnostic quality. Ebner et al. [13] evaluated upper-abdominal MR super-resolution reconstruction with expert readers, reporting subjective preference and anatomical clarity scores for clinically relevant structures. In brain MRI, Rudie et al. [40] prospectively evaluated deep learning-based resolution enhancement using four board-certified neuroradiologists who scored SNR, anatomic conspicuity, overall image quality, artefacts and diagnostic confidence on a Likert scale. These studies show that expert review is often needed when the relevant endpoint is diagnostic interpretability rather than numerical agreement with a reference image.
blocks.zh: 若干磁共振 因此,SR和加速重建研究纳入了专家读者研究,直接评估临床图像质量. 肖达里等. [8] 使用定量度量和放射学家的读取者研究,对肌肉骨骼核磁共振作评价,读者评估锐度、对比度、手工艺品、SNR和总体诊断质量。 Ebner等人著. [13] 与专家读者评价上位MR超解析重建,报告临床相关结构的主观偏好和解剖清晰分数. 在脑磁共振中,Rudie等. [40] 利用四名经板认证的神经放射学家对深层以学习为基础的分辨率增强进行预期评价,这些神经放射学家得分为SNR、原子精度、整体图像质量、手工艺品和诊断信任度等。 这些研究表明,当相关终点是可诊断性而非与参考图像的数字一致时,往往需要专家审查。

blocks.en: Task-based evaluation provides another complementary route. In medical image SR, Zhang et al. [56] showed that improvements in conventional image-quality metrics do not necessarily translate into improved signal-detection, motivating evaluation against clinically or analytically meaningful tasks. More recent biomedical SR benchmarks have similarly assessed whether SR improves downstream segmentation or classification rather than only image similarity [ 3 ] . Together, these works suggest that a robust SR evaluation should combine full-reference metrics where valid references exist, qualitative or expert assessment where references are unavailable or imperfect, and downstream task evaluation where the reconstructed images are intended to support automated analysis.
blocks.zh: 以任务为基础的评价提供了另一种补充途径。 在医学形象SR中,张等. [56] 显示,常规图像质量计量的改进并不一定转化为信号检测的改进,推动对照临床或分析上有意义的任务进行评价。 较近期的生物医学SR基准同样评估了SR是改进下游分出还是分类,而不是仅仅图像相似性[3]. 这些著作合在一起表明,强有力的SR评价应结合全面参考度量衡(如果有有效的参考度量衡)、没有参考度或参考度不完善的定性或专家评估(如果重建的图像旨在支持自动化分析的话)和下游任务评价。

We then define the training objective ( Section 3.6 ) and inference procedure for clinical stacks ( Section 3.7 ).

Per-orientation variational encoders. Each orientation k ∈ { Ax , Cor , Sag } k\in\{\text{Ax},\text{Cor},\text{Sag}\} is processed by an independent encoder E ϕ k E_{\phi_{k}} with S = 4 S=4 downsampling stages. At each scale s ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } s\in\{0,1,2,3\} , a 1 × 1 × 1 1{\times}1{\times}1 variational projection produces voxel-wise mean μ k , s \mu_{k,s} and log-variance ℓ k , s = log ⁡ σ k , s 2 \ell_{k,s}=\log\sigma_{k,s}^{2} maps. blocks.en: The encoder and decoder are built from residual blocks without activation normalisation layers, using LeakyReLU activations and residual scaling [ 31 ] . blocks.en: 3.3 Spectrally normalised variational head

blocks.en: The encoder and decoder are built without activation normalisation layers such as batch, instance or group normalisation. This design choice is motivated by the regression nature of MRI super-resolution, where the network must preserve absolute and relative intensity relationships in the reconstructed image. However, removing activation normalisation also removes a common source of training stabilisation. This is particularly important in a variational architecture, where the encoder predicts voxel-wise Gaussian parameters rather than deterministic features alone.
blocks.zh: 编码器和解码器是在不激活正常化层(如批量,实例或组态)的情况下被构建的. 这种设计选择的动机是核磁共振超分辨率的回归性质,其中网络必须在被重建的图像中保持绝对和相对的强度关系. 然而,去除活化正常化也会去除训练稳定的一个共同来源. 这在可变结构中尤其重要,其中编码器预测的是阴道高斯参数,而不只是确定性特征。

blocks.en: High-capacity variational encoder-decoders can be difficult to train because the posterior parameterisation must remain both expressive and well regularised. Small perturbations in the predicted log-variance can lead to large changes in the posterior precision and KL divergence [ 9 ] , while overly expressive decoders or poorly balanced KL terms can encourage posterior collapse, where the latent variables carry little information about the input [ 49 ] . We therefore use two complementary stabilisation mechanisms: spectral normalisation [ 34 ] to constrain the encoders that predict Gaussian parameters, and free-bits KL regularisation [ 27 ] to reduce posterior collapse.

blocks.en:
We apply spectral normalisation to the convolutional layers in the residual pathways and to the 1 × 1 × 1 1{\times}1{\times}1 variational projections. Spectral normalisation acts on the layer weights rather than on the intermediate feature activations. It constrains the operator norm of the corresponding mapping and therefore limits the sensitivity of the predicted posterior mean and log-variance to small perturbations in the input features. Although spectral normalisation was introduced for stabilising GAN discriminators [ 34 ] , we use it here for its weight-level effect rather than for any adversarial objective.
Importantly, spectral normalisation is not used as a replacement for batch, instance or group normalisation. Those methods normalise feature activations and may alter intensity statistics, whereas spectral normalisation constrains selected weights without normalising the feature maps themselves.

我们把光谱常态化应用到 剩余路径的分层 和1×1×1×1×1=1 变异预测。 光谱正常化作用于地层重量而不是中间特征活化. 它制约了相应的映射的操作者规范,并因此将所预测的后期平均值和日志变量的灵敏度限制在输入特征上的小扰动. 虽然光谱常态化是用来稳定GAN歧视者[34],但是我们用它来做重量级效应而不是任何对抗目标.

blocks.en: The perceptual term ℒ perc \mathcal{L}_{\textrm{perc}} is implemented as a 2.5D AlexNet-based feature loss. Perceptual losses compare images in the feature space of a pretrained CNN and better capture visually relevant differences than purely voxel-wise objectives in reconstruction and synthesis [ 25 , 55 ] , including MRI reconstruction [ 16 ] . We compute the feature distance on 2D slices sampled from the reconstructed and reference volumes, following recent 2.5D perceptual supervision for volumetric medical images [ 35 ] , because fully 3D perceptual losses are memory intensive and require suitable pretrained 3D feature extractors. AlexNet provides a lightweight perceptual backbone commonly used in LPIPS-style metrics [ 55 ] . This term is used as an auxiliary loss alongside Charbonnier, SSIM and KL terms to encourage sharper structural detail without replacing voxel-wise fidelity constraints.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation design
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设计

blocks.en: The evaluation was designed to test five complementary properties of MS-HVED: 1. Reconstruction fidelity relative to single-stack, self-supervised, and fixed-input supervised baselines. 2. The ability of one trained model to accept arbitrary non-empty subsets of axial, coronal, and sagittal stacks. 3. The effect of dataset-specific versus sequence-agnostic training. 4. The contributions of oblique partial-FOV simulation and FOV-aware fusion. 5. Generalisation to real multi-stack acquisitions. The first four questions were evaluated using synthetic data with known HR targets. Real-data performance was assessed using both a paired LR–HR cohort and a blinded expert-reader study using seven board-certified neuroradiologists.
blocks.zh: 评价旨在测试MS-HVED的五个互补特性: 1. 相对于单层、自我监督和固定投入监督基线的重建忠诚度。 2. 一个训练有素的模型能够接受任意的非空子集轴地、冠地和地平线堆栈。 3. 特定数据集对序列不可知性培训的影响。 4. oblique-part-FOV模拟和FOV-意识聚变的贡献。 5. 普及到真正的多层采购。 使用已知人力资源目标的合成数据评估了前四个问题。 利用7名经理事会认证的神经放射学家对一对LR-HR组和盲目专家-阅读器研究进行了真实数据性能评估。

blocks.en: 4.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Source MRI cohorts
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 国家 源核磁共振组群

blocks.en: Three high-resolution (HR) brain MRI cohorts were used as source data for training and synthetic evaluation. The first was an internal meningioma cohort (MEN) comprising 774 774 T1-weighted volumes acquired under heterogeneous clinical protocols. The second and third were the publicly available IXI T1-weighted and T2-weighted cohorts [ 24 ] . The internal cohort was split into 537 / 110 / 127 537/110/127 training/validation/test cases, while the IXI T1-weighted and T2-weighted cohorts comprised 406 / 88 / 87 406/88/87 and 404 / 88 / 86 404/88/86 training/validation/test volumes, respectively.
blocks.zh: 三个高分辨(HR)脑磁共振组群被用作培训和合成评价的来源数据。 第一个是内部脑膜炎组群(MEN),由774 774个T1加权体积组成,根据不同的临床规程获得。 第二批和第三批是可公开使用的IX T1加权和T2加权组群[24]. 内部组群分为537/110/127 537/110/127培训/鉴定/测试案例,而九一T1加权和T2加权组群分别由406/88/87 406/88/87和404/88/86404/88/86培训/鉴定/测试卷组成。

blocks.en: The internal clinical data were accessed under the AI-driven Management of Brain Tumours (AIMBraTS) study, approved by the NHS Research Ethics Committee (REC reference: 22/NS/0160; IRAS ID: 320754). Individual patient consent was not required because the study involved retrospective analysis of routinely collected clinical data. All internal data were handled in accordance with the UK Data Protection Act 2018 [ 44 ] and UK General Data Protection Regulation [ 45 ] . The IXI dataset is publicly available and was used in accordance with its data-access conditions.
blocks.zh: 内部临床数据是在AI驱动的脑肿瘤管理(AIMBraTS)研究下获取的,该研究得到了NHS研究伦理委员会的批准(REC参考:22/NS/0160;IRAS ID:320754). 无需个别病人同意,因为这项研究涉及对例行收集的临床数据的追溯性分析。 所有内部数据都按照"2018年英国数据保护法"[44]和"英国一般数据保护条例"[45]处理. 第九十一套数据集是公开的,按照数据存取条件使用.

blocks.en: All HR volumes were defaced [ 15 ] , resampled to 1 ​ mm 1\mathrm{mm} isotropic resolution using trilinear interpolation, and intensity-normalised to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
blocks.zh: 所有HR卷被分解出 [15],通过三线插值被再被复制到1毫米 1\ mathrm{mm}的异热带分辨率,并被强度规范到 [0, 1] [0, 1].

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Synthetic LR–HR data
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 合成LR-HR数据

blocks.en: The HR volumes described above were used to generate synthetic anisotropic LR stacks using the physics-informed forward model in Section 3 . For each HR volume, axial, coronal and sagittal stacks were generated with randomised acquisition parameters, including anisotropic resolution, oblique prescription, partial-FOV coverage and image artefacts. The original HR volume served as the reference target for supervised training or full-reference quantitative evaluation depending on which split they were assigned to.
blocks.zh: 上面描述的HR卷被用来利用第3节中物理知情的前进模型生成合成同位素LR堆. 对于每个HR体积,轴、冠和平面堆栈都用随机化的获取参数生成,包括异同位素解析度、斜向处方、部分FOV覆盖和图像工艺品。 最初的人力资源量是监督培训或全面参考定量评价的参考指标,视其分配到哪个部门而定。

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Real evaluation cohorts
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 (中文(简体) ). 实际评价组别

blocks.en: To assess generalisation to real multi-stack acquisitions, we evaluated MS-HVED on three additional cohorts. The first consisted of 7 7 paired LR–HR T2-weighted healthy-control brain MRI cases from Ebner et al. [13] . The HR acquisition is used as a pseudo-reference for quantitative evaluation, because the LR and HR scans are necessarily acquired with different acquisition settings. Consequently, differences in contrast, intensity scale and image appearance may reflect acquisition-physics mismatch rather than reconstruction error alone. This 7 7 cases were also included in the expert-reader study, allowing the reference-based and subjective assessments to be interpreted together.
blocks.zh: 为了评估通用到真正的多层采购,我们评估了MS-HVED另外三个组别. 第一个病例包括来自Ebner等人的7起7对LR-HR T2-加权健康控制脑磁共振病例。 [13] (中文(简体) ). HR收购被用作定量评价的伪参考,因为LR和HR扫描的收购必然有不同的收购设置. 因此,在对比度、强度尺度和图像外观上的差异可能反映购置-物理不匹配,而不只是重建出错。 这7个案例也被列入了专家阅读者研究,使得基于参考和主观的评估得以一并解释.

blocks.en: The second cohort consisted of 7 7 low-resolution multi-stack meningioma cases from our institution, acquired under the AIMBraTS study approval described above (REC reference: 22/NS/0160; IRAS ID: 320754). These cases contain clinically relevant tumour pathology but do not have matched 3D HR reference acquisitions. In this cohort, 6 6 of the 7 7 cases contain only two orientations, providing a realistic test for missing orientation.
blocks.zh: 第二组包括7起低分辨率多层脑膜炎病例,这些病例是根据上文提到的AIMBraTS研究批准的(REC参考:22/NS/0160;IRAS ID:320754)。 这些病例包含临床相关的肿瘤病理学,但没有对应的3D HR参考文献. 在这一组案件中,7起案件中有6起只包含两个取向,为缺失取向提供了一个现实的检验标准。

blocks.en: The third cohort was drawn from the publicly available Nigerian clinical MRI dataset [ 51 , 52 ] . The full dataset contains scans from 35 35 healthy participants, 31 31 individuals with age-related dementia and 22 22 individuals with Parkinson’s disease, with T1-weighted, T2-weighted, FLAIR and DWI acquisitions. We used 30 30 cases (consisting of T1-weighted, T2-weighted and FLAIR images) from this cohort as an additional reference-free clinical generalisation test, reflecting acquisition and population characteristics distinct from the training cohorts.
blocks.zh: 第三组来自公开的尼日利亚临床核磁共振数据集[51、52]。 全套数据集包含35名健康参与者、31名患有与年龄有关的痴呆症的个人和22名患有帕金森病的个人的扫描数据,其中T1加权、T2加权、FLAIR和DWI购置。 我们使用了30个病例(包括T1加权、T2加权和FLAIR图像),作为额外的无参考临床归纳测试,反映了与培训组不同的获取和人口特征。

blocks.en: For all real evaluation cohorts, the available LR stacks were rigidly registered to a common reference space and resampled to 1 , mm 1,\mathrm{mm} isotropic resolution. When no matched HR reference was available, the reconstruction grid was defined by the union of the available LR stack supports.
blocks.zh: 对所有真正的评价组,可用的 LR 堆栈被刚性地注册到一个共同的参考空间,并被重印到 1, mm 1,\ mathrm{ mm} 异热带分辨率 。 当没有匹配的 HR 引用时,重建网格由可用的 LR 堆栈支持的结合来定义.

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Quantitative metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 量化指标

blocks.en: Quantitative evaluation of MRI super-resolution is not straightforward because different metrics capture different aspects of reconstruction quality. Voxel-wise errors such as mean absolute error (MAE) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) measure numerical agreement with a reference image, but they may favour smooth reconstructions and can be sensitive to small contrast differences. 3D structural similarity (SSIM) [ 50 ] provides a complementary measure of local structural similarity, while perceptual losses are more sensitive to image sharpness and feature-level differences. For this reason, we report multiple metrics rather than relying on a single score.
blocks.zh: 对核磁共振超分辨率的定量评价不是直截了当的,因为不同的衡量标准涵盖了重建质量的不同方面。 Voxel-wise错误,如平均绝对出错(MAE)和峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR)用参考图像测量数值协议,但它们可能有利于平滑重建并能够敏感地反映小的对比差异. 3D结构相似性(SSIM)[50]提供了局部结构相似性的补充度量,而知觉损失则对图像锐度和地物级差异更为敏感. 为此,我们报告多种衡量标准,而不是依靠单一的分数。

blocks.en: On synthetic data, we report MAE, PSNR, SSIM, and the 2.5D AlexNet-based perceptual loss. Metrics are computed over the HR target region captured by the input stacks used by each method, as described below:

blocks.en: On the paired healthy-control real cohort, we report PSNR, SSIM, normalised cross-correlation (NCC), and perceptual loss against the HR pseudo-reference. Since the LR and HR images were acquired separately and may differ in intensity scale, contrast and scanner-dependent appearance, metrics are computed after linear calibration of each reconstruction to the HR pseudo-reference using ordinary least squares, x ^ cal = a ​ x ^ + b , \hat{x}_{\textrm{cal}}=a\hat{x}+b, where a a and b b are estimated by ordinary least squares. This calibration removes global linear intensity differences, allowing PSNR and SSIM to better reflect spatial and structural agreement. NCC is also reported because it is insensitive to global linear intensity variations.
blocks.zh: 在对齐的健康控制真实组群中,我们报告PSNR,SSIM, 正常的交叉对接(NCC), 和对HR伪引用的知觉损失. 由于 LR 和 HR 图像是单独获得的,在强度尺度、对比度和扫描仪依赖的外观上可能有所不同,因此在将每次重建线性校正到 HR 伪引用后,用普通最小平方计算出指标, x ^ cal = a x ^ + b,\hat{x}_{\textrm{cal}}=a\ hat{x}+b, a和b 由普通最小平方估计出. 这种校正消除了全球线性强度差异,使PSNR和SSIM能够更好地反映空间和结构上的一致. 还报告了NCC,因为它对全球线性强度变化不敏感.

blocks.en: To assess whether image-level improvements translate to improved downstream analysis, we evaluate tissue segmentation performance on the synthetic test sets. SynthSeg [ 6 ] is applied to the axial LR inputs, SegResNet reconstructions and MS-HVED reconstructions. Segmentations obtained from the corresponding HR volumes are used as reference segmentations. We evaluate cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), grey matter (GM), and white matter (WM) using Dice score and the 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD 95 , in mm). This provides a task-oriented evaluation of whether the reconstructed images preserve anatomical structures relevant to automated brain analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了评估图像层面的改进是否转化为改进后下游分析,我们评价了合成测试组上的组织分化性能. SynthSeg [6]被应用于轴 LR 输入,SegResNet 重建以及MS-HVED重建. 从相应的人力资源卷中获得的分块用作参考分块。 我们对脑脊液(CSF),灰质物(GM),和白质物(WM)进行评价,使用Dice分数和95-百分数Husdorff距离(HD 95,以毫米为单位). 这对重建的图像是否保存了与自动化脑分析相关的解剖结构提供了面向任务的评价.

blocks.en: 4.5 Expert-reader study
blocks.zh: 4.5 专家阅读员研究

blocks.en: Reference-free clinical evaluation is necessary for the real cohorts because no isotropic HR reference is available. In these cohorts, image quality is assessed by expert review using a blinded side-by-side rating protocol. Seven board-certified neuroradiologists were shown SegResNet and MS-HVED reconstructions in random order with method labels hidden. Cases were reviewed on a dedicated interface that allows multi-planar inspection of the reconstructed volumes and comparison against the available LR inputs. A screenshot of this interface is provided in Figure A.1 .
blocks.zh: 对于真正的群体来说,必须进行无参考的临床评估,因为没有异热带的人力资源参考。 在这些组别中,图像质量由专家利用被蒙蔽的相邻评级协议加以评估。 7名经板认证的神经辐射学家被显示为SegResNet和MS-HVED的随机重建,方法标签被隐藏. 通过一个专门的接口对案件进行了审查,该接口允许对已重建的体积进行多行星检查,并与现有的LR投入进行比较。 图A.1提供了这一界面的截图。

blocks.en: Experts score each reconstruction on a 1 1 – 9 9 ordinal scale for the following criteria: freedom from artefact, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), sharpness, visibility of tumour pathology where applicable, and overall image quality. Reconstructions were assessed in pairs, and readers were not permitted to assign the same score to both methods for a given case and criterion, thereby requiring a directional preference while retaining the ordinal rating scale. This introduces a forced choice component analogous to pairwise and two-alternative forced choice (2AFC) assessment [ 18 ] . All criteria were scored with higher values indicating better image quality. The pathology-visibility criterion was applied only to cases with visible focal pathology, i.e. the meningioma cohort, and was marked not applicable for the others.
blocks.zh: 专家对每次重建的评分以11-9分9分的平分标准如下:免动脉动,信号与噪声之比(SNR),锐度,肿瘤病理的能见度(如适用),以及整体图像质量. 重建被一对一地评估,读者不允许为特定案例和标准分配相同的分数,从而要求在保留正数分数表的同时要求方向偏好. 这引入了一个强制选择部分,类似于对偶和两种替代强制选择评估[18]。 所有标准的评分值都较高,表明图像质量更好。 病理可视性标准只适用于有明显焦病的病例,即脑膜炎组群,并标记不适用于其他病例。

blocks.en: Input availability was tracked separately from cohort. In some cases, one or more stacks were unavailable, so they could not be used for reconstruction or displayed in the review interface. In other cases, an axial or coronal stack was available and remained visible to the reader in the interface, but was deliberately omitted from both reconstruction methods to test performance with a missing input. For each case, we recorded which orientation stacks were available, which were used for reconstruction, and whether an unused stack was naturally unavailable or deliberately omitted. Results were then grouped according to the inputs used for reconstruction: full input, axial omitted, or coronal omitted.
blocks.zh: 投入提供情况与组别分开跟踪。 在某些情况下,没有一个或多个堆栈,因此无法用于重建或在审查界面中显示. 在其他情况下,一个轴或冠堆可以使用,在界面中仍能被读者所看到,但被故意省略了两种重建方法,用缺失的输入来测试性能. 对于每个案例,我们记录了哪些方向堆栈可供使用,哪些用于重建,以及一个未使用的堆栈是自然没有的还是故意省略的. 然后,根据用于重建的投入对结果进行分组:全部投入、轴省略或冠省略。

Within each cohort or input group, MS-HVED and SegResNet ratings from the same reader and case were compared using two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Synthetic dataset evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 合成数据集评价

blocks.en: As summarized in Table 1 , MS-HVED was competitive across all three synthetic test cohorts. With three inputs, it obtained the best MAE, PSNR, SSIM, and perceptual loss on MEN. It also achieves the best MAE, PSNR, and SSIM on IXI-T1, with perceptual loss tied, and the second-best values on IXI-T2, where three-input SegResNet performed best. When tested on two inputs, MS-HVED still remained competitive with fixed-input baselines, particularly for SSIM on MEN and IXI-T1. Representative synthetic reconstructions are shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 如表1所概述,MS-HVED在所有三个合成试验组中都具有竞争力。 通过3个投入,它获得了最好的MAE,PSNR,SSIM,以及MEN的认知损失. 它还在IXI-T1上实现了最佳MAE,PSNR,和SSIM,并附带了知觉损失,在IXI-T2上达到了第二好值,其中由三输入的SegResNet表现最好. 在两项投入测试时,MS-HVED在固定投入基线方面仍然具有竞争力,特别是在MEN和XI-T1上的SSIM方面。 代表性合成重建如图2所示。

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Flexible orientation handling
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 灵活定向处理

blocks.en: The same MS-HVED model was evaluated with two additional dual-input combinations. As shown in Table 2 , performance was similar for Ax+Sag and Cor+Sag on every test cohort. Across the three cohorts, the absolute PSNR difference between these input combinations was at most 0.75 0.75 dB. These results support the intended use of one model with different available orientation subsets, without retraining a separate network for each subset.
blocks.zh: 同一MS-HVED模式通过另外两个双重输入组合得到了评价. 如表2所示,每个测试组的Ax+Sag和Cor+Sag的性能相似。 在三个组别中,这些输入组合之间的绝对PSNR差异最多为0.75 0.75分贝. 这些结果支持一个模式的预期使用,该模式有不同的可用方向子集,而不对每个子集进行再培训。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Sequence-agnostic reconstruction
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 顺序不可知的重建

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , sequence-agnostic training remained competitive with dataset-specific training. It improved PSNR and perceptual loss on IXI-T1 and MEN, and achieved the lowest perceptual loss on IXI-T2. The dataset-specific models retained higher SSIM on IXI-T1 and IXI-T2 and higher PSNR on IXI-T2. Thus, a shared model reduced the need for contrast/sequence specific training while maintaining comparable performance across cohorts.

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 读取性研究

blocks.en: We ablate the two geometric components introduced to make MS-HVED robust to realistic multi-stack acquisition settings: oblique and partial-FOV of simulated datasets, and FOV-aware mask in PoG fusion. The first component exposes the model to stacks whose spatial supports are rotated, incomplete and only partially overlapping, matching the geometry commonly observed in clinical multi-orientation acquisitions. The second component provides voxel-wise information during fusion, allowing the model to distinguish between valid low-resolution evidence and regions where an orientation does not contribute anatomical information.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了为使MS-HVED强大到现实的多层获取设置而引入的两个几何元件:模拟数据集的斜面和部分FOV,以及PoG聚变中的FOV-意识口罩. 第一个组件使模型暴露出空间支持被旋转,不完整并仅部分重叠的堆栈,与临床多定向获取中常见的几何相匹配. 第二个组件在聚变过程中提供阴道信息,使模型能够区分有效的低分辨率证据和定向不能提供解剖信息的区域.

blocks.en: As presented in Table 4 , oblique partial-FOV simulation produced the largest improvement, and FOV-mask conditioning provided a further consistent benefit. Relative to the variant with neither component, the complete model improved PSNR by 6.06 6.06 , 5.89 5.89 , and 4.46 4.46 dB on MEN, IXI-T1, and IXI-T2, respectively. Adding the masks to the FOV-simulated model further improved SSIM by .014 .014 – .049 .049 and reduced perceptual loss by .031 .031 – .039 .039 .
blocks.zh: 如表4所示,斜向部分FOV模拟产生了最大的改进,FOV-mask调节提供了进一步的一致效益. 相对于两个组件都没有的变体,完整的型号分别改进了6.06 6.06, 5.89 5.89, 和4.46 4.46 dB 在 MEN, XI-T1 和 XI-T2上. 在FOV模拟模型中添加口罩后,将SSIM进一步改进为:014 – 014 – 049 049,并减少了知觉损失:031 031 – 039 039 .

blocks.en: 5.1.4 Downstream evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1.4 下游评价

blocks.en: We assess downstream utility using SynthSeg [ 6 ] on the synthetic test cases, treating the segmentations of the HR volumes as reference segmentations. Dice score and the 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD 95 , in mm) for CSF, GM, and WM are presented in Table 5 , with a representative case visualized in the appendix ( Figure A.4 ).

blocks.en: 5.2 Real-data evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.2 实际数据评价

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Paired real cohort
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 实际群体

blocks.en: The 7 7 paired real cases permitted comparison with a separately acquired HR pseudo-reference. As presented in Table 6 , the FOV-weighted stack average achieved the highest PSNR, SSIM, and NCC. These metrics tend to favour smoother reconstructions with strong voxel-wise and structural agreement, and may therefore not fully reflect perceptual sharpness or preservation of fine anatomical detail. MS-HVED achieved the lowest perceptual loss and improved over SegResNet in every reported metric. However, the HR images were separate acquisitions rather than exact ground truth. We therefore retained these full-reference results and complemented them with expert ratings of the same seven cases in Section 5.3 .
blocks.zh: 7起对齐的真实案例允许与单独获得的人力资源伪参照进行比较。 如表6所示,FOV加权堆栈平均值达到了最高的PSNR,SSIM和NCC. 这些度量衡往往倾向于以强烈的阴道和结构一致来进行更平稳的重建,因此可能无法充分反映知觉锐利或保存精细的解剖细节. MS-HVED在每一个报告指标中实现了最低的知觉损失,并且比SegResNet有所改善。 然而,人力资源图象是单独的采购,而不是准确的真相。 因此,我们保留了这些全面参考结果,并在第5.3节对同样的7个案例给予专家评分。

Best and second-best values computed in the present evaluation are bolded and underlined; published NiftyMIC values are included for context and excluded from this ranking.
blocks.zh: 表6:对7起7对真实案例的全面参考评价。 独立获得的HR图像被视为伪参考。 值为平均值±\pm标准偏差. 本评价中计算出的最佳和二等数值为粗体和下划线;已公布的NiftyMIC值按上下文列出,不在此列。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Reference-free clinical cohorts
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 无参考临床群体

blocks.en: The meningioma examples in Figure 3 show reconstruction behaviour in the presence of tumour pathology and naturally missing orientations. Qualitative examples from the paired healthy and Nigerian cohorts are provided in the appendix ( Figure A.2 and A.3 ). As no matched HR acquisitions existed for the meningioma and Nigerian cohorts, conclusions for these data are based on the reader study rather than full-reference metrics.

blocks.en: 5.3 Expert-reader results
blocks.zh: 5.3 专家阅读结果

blocks.en: Seven board-certified neuroradiologists evaluated 44 cases (30 Nigerian clinical cases, 7 meningioma cases, and 7 healthy-control cases), yielding 308 paired case–reader assessments. By cohort, these comprised 210 Nigerian, 49 meningioma, and 49 healthy-control assessments. By input condition, 182 assessments used every available stack, 42 omitted an available axial stack, and 84 omitted an available coronal stack. Pathology visibility was applicable only to the 7 meningioma cases and had 49 paired assessments.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , MS-HVED received higher mean scores than SegResNet for every applicable criterion in the Nigerian and meningioma cohorts. All comparisons were significant with p < .001 p<.001 . For overall quality, MS-HVED was preferred in 187 of 210 Nigerian pairs and 47 of 49 meningioma pairs.

blocks.en: 5.3.3 Scale-invariant preference and inter-rater variability
blocks.zh: 5.3.3 比例变化偏好和比率之间的可变性

blocks.en: The reader-level net paired-preference analysis in Figure 4 removes differences in how readers used the numerical scale. blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: This study demonstrates that MS-HVED can reconstruct isotropic brain MRI from variable subsets of anisotropic multi-orientation stacks while accounting for the spatial extent of each acquisition. Across complementary evaluations, the method achieved competitive or leading reconstruction fidelity, preserved downstream tissue-segmentation performance, and was preferred to SegResNet by expert neuroradiologists when evaluating real clinical data.
blocks.zh: 这项研究表明,MS-HVED能够从异同位素多向堆栈的可变子集重建异同位素脑磁共振,同时计算每次获取的空间范围. 在整个补充性评价中,该方法实现了竞争性或领先性重建忠心,保留了下游组织分层性能,并在评价真实临床数据时被神经辐射专家选入了SegResNet.

blocks.en: 6.1 Acquisition-aware fusion improves robustness to clinical geometry
blocks.zh: 6.1 获取-认识聚变提高临床几何学的稳健性

blocks.en: Geometric ablation provides the clearest evidence for the importance of acquisition-aware modelling. Introducing oblique and partial-FOV simulation during training increased PSNR by 4.46 4.46 – 6.06 6.06 dB compared with training without realistic acquisition geometry. Incorporating FOV masks produced further improvements, particularly in SSIM and perceptual loss.
blocks.zh: 几何衰减为了解获取-认知建模的重要性提供了最明确的证据. 在培训期间采用偏斜和部分FOV模拟法使PSNR增加了4.46 4.46 – 6.06 6.06分贝,而培训没有现实的获得几何学。 将FOV口罩纳入其中产生了进一步的改进,特别是在SSIM和感知损失方面。

blocks.en: These components address related but distinct sources of variation. The domain-randomisation pipeline exposes the model to rotated, incomplete, and partially overlapping acquisitions during training, whereas the FOV masks determine where each orientation should contribute during fusion. This allows MS-HVED to reconstruct over the union of available acquisitions without treating resampled background or unsupported voxels as valid measurements.
blocks.zh: 这些组成部分涉及相关但独特的变异源。 域域随机化管道使模型暴露出在训练过程中旋转,不完整和部分重叠的获取,而FOV口罩则决定了每个方向在聚变过程中应作哪些贡献. 这使得MS-HVED能够在现有收购的结合之上重建,而无需将被重印的背景或不支持的活塞作为有效的测量.

blocks.en:
6.2 MS-HVED supports variable orientations, contrasts,
reconstruction grids,
and stochastic inference
blocks.zh:
6.2 MS-HVED支持可变方向,对比度,
重建电网,
和划时代的推论

blocks.en: A key benefit of MS-HVED is that one trained model can operate on different subsets of axial, coronal and sagittal stacks. The model maintained similar performance across Ax+Cor , Ax+Sag and Cor+Sag configurations without requiring a separate network for each input combination, unlike fixed-input supervised baselines. This flexibility is important for retrospective and clinical datasets, where stacks may be absent because of protocol differences, incomplete examinations, motion corruption or acquisition failure.
blocks.zh: MS-HVED的一个关键好处是,一个训练有素的模型可以在轴线,冠线和相片堆放的不同子集上运行. 该模型在Ax+Cor,Ax+Sag和Cor+Sag配置之间保持了相近的性能,而不需要为每个输入组合单设一个网络,与固定投入监督基线不同. 这种灵活性对于追溯数据和临床数据集很重要,因为协议差异、检查不完整、运动腐败或获取失败,这些数据集可能不存在堆栈。

blocks.en: The sequence-agnostic experiment demonstrated a related trade-off. A single model jointly trained on IXI-T1, IXI-T2, and MEN remained competitive with dataset-specific models and improved several PSNR, MAE, and perceptual results, although it did not achieve the best result for every metric.
blocks.zh: 序列-不可知性实验展示了相关的取舍. 联合培训的关于IXI-T1、IXI-T2和MEN的单一模型仍然具有特定数据集模型的竞争力,并改进了几个PSNR、MAE和知觉结果,尽管它并没有为每个衡量标准取得最佳结果。

blocks.en: Additionally, since MS-HVED is fully convolutional, its inference is not tied to a fixed grid. A model trained using 1mm isotropic targets can therefore be evaluated on a finer reconstruction grid, e.g. 0.5mm. We demonstrate this resolution flexibility across acquisitions with different native resolutions and field strengths in Section A.5 .
blocks.zh: 此外,由于MS-HVED是完全演化的,其推论没有固定的网格. 因此,使用1毫米同地线目标培训的模型可以在更细的重建网格上进行评估,例如0.5毫米。 在A.5节,我们以不同本地决议和实地优势,在采购过程中表现出了这项决议的灵活性。

blocks.en: Lastly, the variational formulation of MS-HVED provides an additional capability beyond the deterministic reconstructions evaluated. At inference, the fused multi-scale posterior can be decoded at its mean, as used for all reported experiments, or sampled repeatedly to produce stochastic multi-sample reconstructions. Repeated samples can expose regions in which the reconstruction is sensitive to latent uncertainty. This is particularly relevant where one or more orientations are missing or have limited coverage. Establishing such dispersion as a calibrated measure of reconstruction uncertainty will require dedicated validation, nevertheless, multi-sample inference follows directly from the fused posterior and does not require a change to the trained architecture.
blocks.zh: 最后,MS-HVED的可变配制在评价的确定性重建之外提供了额外的能力。 推想出,被引信的多级后架可以按其平均值来解码,如用于所有被报道的实验,或者反复取出样品来产生有花样的多样重建. 重复的样品可能暴露重建对潜在不确定性敏感的区域。 在缺少一个或多个指导或覆盖面有限的情况下,这一点尤为重要。 确定这种分散性作为调整后的重建不确定性的衡量标准,将需要专门验证,然而,多样推论直接取自引信后方,不需要改变训练有素的建筑。

blocks.en: 6.3 Full-reference metrics do not capture all reconstruction artefacts
blocks.zh: 6.3 全面参考指标没有涵盖所有重建文物

blocks.en: The experiments highlight the limitations of conventional full-reference metrics for MRI super-resolution. MAE, PSNR and SSIM are useful for controlled synthetic evaluation, but they aggregate errors over the reconstructed volume and may hide localised boundary or wedge-shaped artefacts. This helps explain why SegResNet was competitive on several simulated benchmarks, while expert readers identified poorer image quality. These localised errors include altered signal intensity, loss of anatomical separation, and reduced conspicuity of small structures.
blocks.zh: 实验突出了常规全参考度量衡对核磁共振超分辨率的局限性. MAE、PSNR和SSIM对有控制的合成评价很有用,但它们汇总了重建体积的错误,可能隐藏局部边界或楔形文物。 这有助于解释为什么SegResNet在若干模拟基准上具有竞争力,而专家读者则发现图像质量较差。 这些局部误差包括:信号强度改变,解剖分离丧失,小结构的同感降低等.

blocks.en: 6.4 Expert assessment provides evidence on real clinical image quality
blocks.zh: 6.4 (中文(简体) ). 专家评估提供了真实临床图像质量的证据

blocks.en: The blinded reader study extends the evaluation beyond simulated degradation models and imperfect pseudo-references. Seven expert neuroradiologists assessed 44 cases from the paired healthy, Nigerian, and meningioma cohorts. MS-HVED received higher overall-quality ratings than SegResNet when all available stacks were used and retained its advantage when axial or coronal inputs were withheld. Improvements were also observed for artefact, SNR, and anatomical consistency, while differences in sharpness were less pronounced. This pattern suggests that the preference for MS-HVED was not driven solely by apparent sharpness, but also by cleaner and more anatomically coherent reconstructions.
blocks.zh: 失明读者研究将评价扩展至模拟降解模型和不完善的伪参考. 7名神经辐射专家评估了尼日利亚健康组和脑膜瘤组的44个病例。 在使用所有可用的堆栈时,MS-HVED得到的总体质量评级高于SegResNet,并在轴或冠输入被扣时保留其优势. 人工活性、SNR和解剖一致性也有改进,而锐度的差别不大。 这种模式表明,对MS-HVED的偏好不仅仅是由明显的尖锐性驱动的,而且还是由更清洁和在解剖学上更加连贯的重建所驱动的.

blocks.en: The accompanying reader comments provide further insight into the types of residual errors present in both methods. Figure 5 shows examples of these errors with reader comments. In one healthy-control case, the interpeduncular cistern appeared abnormally dark in both reconstructions, indicating a failure shared by the two learned approaches. In a meningioma case with no sagittal input, the spinal cord was poorly delineated in both reconstructions, although SegResNet showed more pronounced artefacts. Readers also identified several local anatomical inconsistencies in the Nigerian cohort: increased signal within the genu of the corpus callosum in a SegResNet reconstruction, conflation of the left ICA flow void with adjacent structures in both methods but more prominently with SegResNet, and reduced separation between the pituitary gland and clivus in another SegResNet case. These observations complement the quantitative ratings by showing that residual reconstruction errors can be spatially localised and anatomically specific, and may therefore have limited influence on global image-similarity metrics.
blocks.zh: 随附的读者评论使人们进一步深入了解这两种方法中存在的遗留错误的类型。 图5显示了这些错误的例子,并附有读者的评论。 在一个健康控制的情况下,两次重建中都出现了异常地黑暗的相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接的失败. 在一个没有平面输入的脑膜瘤病例中,脊髓在两次重建中都界定得不好,尽管SegResNet显示的手工艺品更为明显。 读者还发现了尼日利亚族中的若干局部解剖不一致之处:在SegResNet重建中,血清计数体的基努内信号增加;在这两种方法中,左ICA流量与相邻结构相混,但与SegResNet更为显著;在另一个SegResNet案件中,垂体腺与克利活体之间的分离减少。 这些观测结果通过显示剩余重建出错可被空间定位和解剖特异性来补充定量评级,因此对全球图像-相似度测量的影响可能有限.

blocks.en: 6.5 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 6.5 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. First, MS-HVED assumes that the available stacks have been rigidly registered and resampled to a common space before fusion. Residual misregistration can introduce inconsistent anatomical evidence that the fusion mechanism cannot fully correct, and registration error is not explicitly simulated during training. Second, although the reader study included multiple acquisition sources, the clinical meningioma cohort contained only seven cases and therefore represented a limited range of tumour appearances and imaging protocols. Larger multi-institutional studies are needed to assess robustness across scanners, field strengths, contrasts, pathologies and acquisition quality, and to determine whether improvements in reconstructed image quality translate into improved diagnostic interpretation.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 首先,MS-HVED假设可用的堆栈在聚变前已经被刚性地注册并被再被复制到一个共同的空间. 残存的误登记可以引入不一致的解剖学证据,证明聚变机制不能完全纠正,注册错误在训练中也没有被明确模拟. 第二,虽然读者研究包括多种获取来源,但临床脑膜炎组群只包含7个病例,因此代表了有限的肿瘤外观和成像协议. 需要进行更大的多机构研究,以评估扫描仪的稳健性、实地优势、对比度、病理和获取质量,并确定重建后图像质量的改善是否转化为更好的诊断解释。

blocks.en: The reader comments also indicate that acquisition-domain shift warrants further investigation. Row (D) of Figure 5 shows a Nigerian case acquired at 0.3 0.3 ,T, both methods showed reduced separation of the left ICA flow void from adjacent structures, with the artefact more pronounced for SegResNet. Since the training cohorts consisted predominantly of 1.5 1.5 ,T and 3 3 ,T acquisitions, differences in SNR and image characteristics at low field may have contributed to this failure. Future work should therefore include dedicated low-field training and evaluation data.
blocks.zh: 读者的评论还表明,购置领域转移需要进一步调查。 图5的行(D)显示一个以0.3 0.3 T得到的尼日利亚病例,这两种方法都显示左相的ICA流与相邻结构相去甚远的分出量减少,而SegResNet的活性更明显. 由于培训组主要包括1.5个1.5个T和3个3个T,因此SNR的差异和低地的图像特征可能是造成这一失败的原因。 因此,今后的工作应包括专门的低地培训和评价数据。

blocks.en: Finally, the discrepancy between competitive simulated metrics and expert observations of local anatomical errors highlights the need for SRR metrics that are sensitive to boundary artefacts, altered signal, anatomical separation and pathology preservation. The stochastic posterior available in MS-HVED may also provide useful uncertainty information, but its calibration and clinical relevance require dedicated validation.
blocks.zh: 最后,竞争性模拟测量标准与专家对局部解剖误差的观察之间的差异突出了对边界文物、改变信号、解剖分离和病理保存敏感的SRR测量标准的必要性。 MS-HVED中可得到的有花样的后缀也可能提供有用的不确定性信息,但其校准和临床相关性需要专门的验证.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: MS-HVED provides a flexible variational framework for reconstructing isotropic brain MRI from the available subset of anisotropic axial, coronal, and sagittal image stacks. Its combination of oblique partial-FOV simulation and spatially aware Product-of-Gaussians fusion allows the model to use valid information from each orientation without assuming identical extent or requiring a separately trained network for every input configuration.
blocks.zh: MS-HVED提供了一个灵活的变异框架,用于从同位素轴线、冠线线和相片图像堆栈的现有子集重建异地脑磁共振。 它结合了oblique part-FOV模拟和空间意识的Product-of-Gausians聚变,使模型能够使用来自每个取向的有效信息,而无需假设相同范围,也不要求每个输入配置需要经过单独训练的网络.

blocks.en: Across synthetic and real (paired and reference-free) clinical evaluations, MS-HVED achieved competitive reconstruction fidelity, preserved downstream tissue segmentation performance, and received higher expert ratings than SegResNet for overall image quality. The reader preference persisted across the Nigerian, meningioma, and paired healthy cohorts and when an axial or coronal input was deliberately omitted. The variational posterior additionally permits stochastic multi-sample inference, providing a basis for future evaluation of reconstruction stability and uncertainty.
blocks.zh: MS-HVED通过合成和真实的(保真和无参考的)临床评价,实现了竞争性的再生忠心,保存了下游组织分解性能,总体图像质量获得的专家评价高于SegResNet. 在尼日利亚、脑膜炎、健康组群的配对以及故意省略轴心或冠心输入时,读者一直偏好。 事后的变异性还允许多样推论,为今后评估重建的稳定性和不确定性提供依据。

blocks.en: These results support MS-HVED as a robust approach for heterogeneous multi-stack brain MRI. Future multi-institutional evaluation will extend the range of datasets and pathologies, address registration-related failures, and determine whether the observed improvements translate into greater diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility.
blocks.zh: 这些结果支持MS-HVED作为多种多层脑磁共振的有力方法. 未来的多机构评价将扩大数据集和病理范围,解决与登记有关的故障,并确定观察到的改进是否转化为更好的诊断准确性和临床实用性。
